---
id: ec:no-production-effect
type: EventConcept
name: No production effect
axis: production_effect
aliases: [continues to feed in, no effect on output, production unaffected]
status: active
---
Production is unaffected: the row says the device continues to feed in, or the message is a status that changes nothing about output.

Reading rule: only an explicit statement ("the inverter continues to feed in", "no effect on operation") or a plainly informational message reads as this concept. Silence about output yields no claim, never this one.
